author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
New to Jira? In this quick tutorial, I’ll show you how to get started fast.

Jira is a powerful project management tool that helps teams track tasks, deadlines, owners, and progress — all in one place. You can view your work like a spreadsheet, move tasks across a board, see timelines on a calendar, and manage projects from start to finish.

Jira also includes built-in AI that can help write task descriptions and automatically generate project updates, saving you time.

If you’re searching for a Jira tutorial for beginners or want a simple walkthrough to understand how it works, this is for you.

👉 Try Jira for free: https://jira.kevinstratvert.com
👉 Watch the full step-by-step Jira tutorial here:
https://youtu.be/GPOWZSxEslU

title: Jira Tutorial for Beginners – How to Get Started Fast
